# HELOC or cash-out refinance: which costs less?

> Free HELOC vs cash-out refinance calculator: total cost of each at the year you sell or refinance, the repricing cost on your existing mortgage, the HELOC rate at which they tie, and a rate shock table. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
